visible_labels.text:
Meta-analysis —  · Binary · Odds ratio
Comparison: Intervention / Control
Model: Fixed-effect inverse-variance
Confidence level: 95%
OR = 1 means equal odds in Intervention and Control; estimates are fitted on the log scale.
A continuity correction of 0.5 was applied to studies with at least one zero cell. The 2 studies with no events in either arm were retained with this correction.
Inference: Normal approximation
